description.message: Let your tafs work in your own Chrome, only on the sites you allow, with every risky step approved on your phone.

pair_title.message: Pair this Chrome with your phone

pair_body.message: On your phone, open tafs, then Account › Chrome › Pair a Chrome. Type the code it shows here.

pair_profile.message: tafs works in its own Chrome profile. Sign in there only to the sites you want your tafs to use.

pair_error_code.message: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Start again on your phone.

pair_error_expired.message: The code expired. Start again on your phone.

pair_error_proof.message: This pairing couldn't be confirmed, so nothing was paired. Start again on your phone.

pair_error_planque.message: tafs couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.

pair_error_not_released.message: This build of the extension can't pair. Install tafs from the Chrome Web Store.

paired_body.message: Your tafs can use this Chrome only on the sites a connection lists. You approve risky steps on your phone.

idle.message: No taf is working here now.

unpair_confirm.message: Unpair this Chrome? Your tafs won't be able to use it until you pair it again.

aside_will.message: Coach reads this page when you send: $HOST$
aside_will.description: Above Coach's message box in the side panel: the page in front goes with the person's next message, read once on Send.

aside_reading.description: Under one of the person's messages to Coach: the page that went with it, by its site.

aside_off.description: Button: Coach never reads pages of this site with a message.

aside_on.description: Button: Coach reads this site's page again when you send.

aside_off_line.message: Coach doesn't read $HOST$: you switched it off
aside_off_line.description: Above Coach's message box, for a site the person switched off.

aside_sensitive.message: Coach doesn't read $HOST$: a bank, payment, mail or health site
aside_sensitive.description: Above Coach's message box, for a sensitive site, which is never read.

group_done.description: Title of a taf's tab group in Chrome once its work there is over (while it works: "Rae is working").

paused_failures.message: Paused after three steps in a row didn't work.

paused_no_progress.message: Paused: the same step changed nothing twice in a row.

hand_title.description: Heading of the card where a taf asks the person to do one thing in the page.

hand_says.description: Label above the taf's own words on the Your turn card; the words are the taf's, never KIFF's or the extension's.

hand_show.description: Button on the Your turn card: brings the page to the front and outlines the field or button.

hand_done.description: Button on the Your turn card: the person did it; the taf reads the page again, without what was typed.

hand_declined.description: Button on the Your turn card: the person won't do it now; the taf is told.

hand_careful.message: Only type where you trust this page.
hand_careful.description: Fixed line on the Your turn card.

hand_show_changed.message: The page has changed since the taf read it, so there's nothing to point to. Look for it as the taf says.
hand_show_changed.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the page is no longer the one the taf read.

hand_show_hidden.message: That field or button isn't on screen right now. A wider window may show it, or look for it as the taf says.
hand_show_hidden.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the field the taf named is hidden or gone (a narrow window can hide a search box).

hand_show_unanswered.message: The page didn't answer. Look for it as the taf says.
hand_show_unanswered.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the page couldn't be asked to outline the field.

hand_show_no_field.message: This is the page. The taf didn't name a field or button to point to.
hand_show_no_field.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the page came to the front; the taf's words say what to do.

bar_go.description: Button on the floating bar shown on the page in front while a taf works in this Chrome: brings the tab the taf is working in to the front.

bar_paused.description: The floating bar's words while the person has paused the taf's work in this Chrome.

step_act_press.description: A step in the side panel's list: the taf pressed Enter, Escape or an arrow key in the page.

step_act_scroll.description: A step in the side panel's list: the taf scrolled the page.

step_act_back.description: A step in the side panel's list: the taf went back to the page before.

step_handed.description: Step list: the taf handed the person one thing to do in the page.

step_hand_done.description: Step list: the person pressed Done on the Your turn card.

step_hand_declined.description: Step list: the person pressed Not now on the Your turn card.

coach_error.message: That didn't reach Coach. Try again.

coach_not_started.message: Start Coach on your phone first.

unpaired.message: This Chrome isn't paired any more. Pair it again from the tafs app on your phone.
unpaired.description: A request refused because the Chrome is unpaired

coach_empty_body_reads.message: It's the same chat as in the tafs app. When Coach works on a page, it reads that page first.
coach_empty_body_reads.description: Empty chat: body. There's no Share button: Coach and tafs read a page themselves.

coach_previous_error.message: The earlier conversations couldn't be loaded.

coach_back.description: Coach's own view: back to the taf's chat.

coach_archive.description: Beside a conversation with Coach: takes it out of the list. It's kept, not deleted.

coach_archive_named.description: Accessible name of a conversation's Archive button.

coach_unarchive.description: Beside an archived conversation: returns it to the list.

coach_unarchive_named.description: Accessible name of an archived conversation's Put back button.

coach_archived.description: The list of conversations with Coach the person archived.

coach_archived_body.message: Each message is kept 30 days from when it was written, archived or not.
coach_archived_body.description: Under Archived: how long its messages are kept, as the privacy page says: 30 days from each message, archived or not.

coach_archive_error.message: That didn't go through. Try again.

taf_remove.description: Under a taf's chat: shows where a taf is removed (on the phone).

taf_remove_on_phone.message: A taf is removed on your phone: open it in the tafs app, then Remove. Its removal is approved there.
taf_remove_on_phone.description: Shown after Remove this taf: the extension can't remove a taf, since removing one is approved on the phone.

tafs_not_read.message: Your tafs couldn't be read. Try again.

no_taf_here.message: No taf works in this Chrome yet.

setup_taf.message: Set up a new taf for this site

at_work.description: Label before the side panel's row of tafs at work, one button each; a button brings that taf's tab to the front.

go_to_taf.description: Accessible name of a taf's button in that row.

page_consent_off.message: Coach doesn't read the page you're on.
page_consent_off.description: Above Coach's message box while the page consent isn't given.

page_consent_turn_on.description: Button that opens the page consent's screen.

page_consent_title.message: Let Coach read the page in front when you send?
page_consent_title.description: Title of the page consent's screen.

page_consent_what.message: When you send a message to Coach here, the text of the tab in front of this window goes with it: its address (without anything after ? or #), its title and its words. Field values and passwords aren't read; card numbers are cut to their last four digits; keys and labelled secrets are masked. One-time codes named as one in English, French, Spanish or German in the page's text are masked too.
page_consent_what.description: The page consent: what is sent.

page_consent_when.message: Only when you send, only that tab, and never a bank, payment, mail or health site, or one you switched off.

page_consent_never.message: It goes to tafs, which sends it to Anthropic's Claude to answer you, as your message does. tafs keeps only the site's name, never the page; Coach's answer may quote it.
page_consent_never.description: The page consent: where it goes and what is kept.

page_consent_change.message: You can send a message without the page at any time, and stop this here whenever you like.
page_consent_change.description: The page consent: sending alone and withdrawing.

page_consent_not_now.description: Closes the page consent's screen, leaving it off.

page_consent_withdraw.description: Withdraws the page consent, beside the line saying which site a send reads.

coach_send_alone.description: Sends the message to Coach with no page, while the page consent is given.

menu_label.description: Accessible name of the side panel's ⋮ menu button, top right.

settings_title.description: The ⋮ menu's item, and the heading of the side panel's Settings screen.

settings_reads_title.message: Coach and the page you're on
settings_reads_title.description: Settings: the heading of the section about Coach reading the page in front.

settings_reads_on.message: Coach reads the page in front when you send it a message.
settings_reads_on.description: Settings: the state line while the page consent is given (page_consent_off says the other state).

settings_chrome_title.description: Settings: the heading of the section about this Chrome, above Unpair.

coach_row_menu.description: Accessible name of a conversation row's ⋯ button, which holds Archive or Put back.

attach_files.description: The + in the composer: picks files to send with the next message.

attach_remove.description: The × on a file picked for the next message.

attach_too_big.message: Too large: at most $SIZE$ for this kind of file

attach_type.message: Can't attach this kind of file. Photos, PDF, text, CSV, Markdown, Word or Excel only.

attach_failed.message: Didn't upload. Remove it and try again.
